description: Execution tracker for MVP completion and full-site launch readiness.

features.description: Clone and audit `vercel/chatbot`, then record what is transplanted versus explicitly discarded.
steps: Clone `vercel/chatbot` into a read-only reference directory.
Inspect app shell, chat layout, empty states, cards, and dashboard patterns.
Write a transplant audit that records what is reused and what is intentionally excluded.

features.description: Replace the minimal shell with a unified Tailwind and shadcn-style component system shared by `/`, `/qa`, and `/admin`.
steps: Install Tailwind and component primitives.
Rebuild the shared app shell, typography system, and color tokens.
Apply the new visual system across public and admin routes.
features.verification: cd frontend && npm test -- --runInBand && npm run build

features.description: Rebuild the homepage and public QA experience with starter prompts, chat history, and concise source labels.
steps: Design a trust-first homepage with employment topics and CTA.
Implement a real multi-message chat layout with loading and error states.
Render concise official and graduate source tags with the final answer.
features.verification: cd frontend && npm test -- --runInBand && npm run build

features.description: Add streaming QA transport while keeping the existing non-streaming fallback contract intact.
steps: Add `POST /api/v1/qa/stream` with `text/event-stream` output.
Implement frontend stream parsing with delta and metadata events.
Keep `/api/v1/qa/ask` available as the compatibility path.

features.description: Replace mock answers with real official-doc and graduate-data retrieval, preserving strict official-first behavior.
steps: Implement real parsing for official docs and graduate data uploads.
Store searchable chunks in a local persisted retrieval index.
Compose answers and source labels from resolved official-first context.

features.description: Rebuild `/admin` as a polished token-based console for uploads, reindexing, and sync visibility.
steps: Implement token login and protected admin actions.
Expose official file upload, graduate upload, reindex, and status cards.
Keep validation and feedback clear enough for future staff handoff.

features.description: Refresh tests, builds, compose validation, and visual captures for the rebuilt product.
steps: Run backend pytest suite.
Run frontend tests and production build.
Validate docker compose and capture fresh screenshots for `/`, `/qa`, and `/admin`.
features.verification: cd backend && . .venv/bin/activate && pytest -q && cd ../frontend && npm test -- --runInBand && npm run build && cd .. && docker compose config

features.description: Finalize delivery hygiene: docs, references, screenshots, branch commits, and remote configuration.
steps: Update README and deployment docs to match the rebuilt architecture.
Store audit notes and screenshots with branch artifacts.
Configure remote for the delivery repo and prepare push-ready branch.
features.verification: git status --short && git log --oneline -1 && git remote -v

features.description: Harden public/admin boundary so admin is not discoverable from public UX and has route-level gate.
steps: Add failing tests for admin visibility and guard behavior.
Implement middleware or equivalent route gate for `/admin`.
Keep admin route accessible only through expected staff flow.

features.description: Add file governance: strict validation, duplicate handling, and explicit ingestion errors for admin uploads.
steps: Write failing API tests for bad format, empty file, and duplicate file behavior.
Implement upload validation and duplicate replacement policy with metadata.
Return structured error messages to improve admin-side diagnosis.

features.description: Expose source evidence (file/snippet) so students can understand why an answer is trustworthy.
steps: Write failing tests for evidence fields in ask/stream response contracts.
Extend backend response schema and retrieval service evidence payload.
Render evidence section in frontend chat response card.
features.verification: cd backend && . .venv/bin/activate && pytest tests/test_public_qa_api.py -q && cd ../frontend && npm test -- --runInBand __tests__/chat-shell.test.tsx

features.description: Add lightweight rate limit, timeout, and retry strategy to prevent QA endpoint degradation.
steps: Write failing tests for rate-limiting and timeout fallback behavior.
Implement throttle + timeout guards on public QA endpoints.
Implement frontend retry/backoff for transient failures.

features.description: Add request ids and structured operation logs for QA and admin operations.
steps: Write failing tests for request id propagation.
Implement middleware and structured logging helper.
Apply logs to ask/stream/upload/reindex endpoints.

features.description: Add full CI and production deployment hardening for repeatable release quality.
steps: Add CI workflow for backend tests, frontend tests/build, and compose validation.
Harden deployment docs and Nginx security/caching config.
Validate all required commands pass in local equivalent.
features.verification: cd backend && . .venv/bin/activate && pytest -q && cd ../frontend && npm test -- --runInBand && npm run build && cd .. && docker compose config

features.description: Complete launch-level UX content: service notice, usage guide, FAQ/help entry, and support block.
steps: Write failing homepage tests for launch support sections.
Add service notice and usage guidance blocks to homepage/qa pages.
Ensure mobile layout and CTA hierarchy stay strong.
features.verification: cd frontend && npm test -- --runInBand __tests__/home-page.test.tsx && npm run build

features.description: Execute end-to-end launch validation and ship release-ready docs/harness state.
steps: Run full backend/frontend verification suite and smoke checks.
Capture new release screenshots for `/`, `/qa`, `/admin`.
Update README and progress logs with launch readiness and known limits.
features.verification: cd backend && . .venv/bin/activate && pytest -q && cd ../frontend && npm test -- --runInBand && npm run build
